notes: Asking price is consistently shown in the span.ere__single-property-price element in the page header. Revenue and cash flow are not published as structured fields on any of the three pages; financial figures (inside sales, fuel volume, etc.) appear only as unstructured free text in the description body with no consistent label or CSS hook, and cash flow/SDE is never mentioned at all.
